sloka: ततो दशरथः प्राप्य पायसम् देव निर्मितम् ।बभूव परम प्रीतः प्राप्य वित्तम् इव अधनः ॥१-१६-२३॥
transliteration: tato daśarathaḥ prāpya pāyasam deva nirmitam ।babhūva parama prītaḥ prāpya vittam iva adhanaḥ ॥1-16-23॥

translations.english: Dasaratha who received the payasam prepared by devatas was highly pleased like a poor man who received wealth.
